create_ecapa_tdnn_model: create an ECAPA-TDNN model for speaker embedding with configurable channels, kernel sizes, and dilations
build_tdnn_block: build a time-delay neural network block with configurable kernel size, dilation, and group convolution
build_seres2net_block: build a SE-Res2Net block combining TDNN, Res2Net, and squeeze-and-excitation for speaker embedding
run_attentive_statistics_pooling: run attentive statistical pooling to compute mean and std with attention over variable-length utterances
test_se_block: test a squeeze-and-excitation block that reweights channel features using global context statistics
